title: 问题即问题：迈向可扩展的数学发现
summary: 提出新的人机协作数学发现范式FAR，从文献中自动搜索候选问题，经多阶段过滤聚焦专家评审，在组合学试点中从5245篇论文中筛选出77项供评审，发现多个重要猜想结果。
summary_en: Proposes FAR, a new human-AI paradigm for mathematical discovery, automating problem search from literature and filtering to focus expert review. In a combinatorics pilot, it reduced 5,245 papers to 77 items for review, yielding notable results.
